fields.name: displayText_DataIssue1
fields.fieldText:
Data check one:

  • There are no quote lines or there are quote lines without an assigned Type.
  • The status of the quote is already Pending or Approved.
  • The price book is inactive.

fields.name: displayText_DataIssue2
fields.fieldText:
Data check two:

  • The Sales Rep does not match the Owner of the opportunity
  • The Expiration Date is greater than the Expiration Date Limit
  • The Expiration Date is less than today's date
  • There are Training products on the quote, but a customer Point of Contact has not been set
  • The customer Point of Contact is not a contact on either the opportunity Account or End User Account

fields.name: displayText_DataIssue3
fields.fieldText:

  • The L1/L2 Support Provider is missing one or more of their verifications and hasn't been granted a Support Exception
  • The Business Motion is MSP and the L1/L2 Support Provider is Tanium Support Center

fields.name: displayText_DataIssue4
fields.fieldText:
Data check four:

  • The Sales Rep does not match the Owner of the opportunity
  • The Expiration Date is greater than the Expiration Date Limit
  • The Expiration Date is less than today's date
  • There are Training products on the quote, but a customer Point of Contact has not been set
  • The customer Point of Contact is not a contact on either the opportunity Account or End User Account

fields.name: displayText_DataIssue5
fields.fieldText:

  • A Billing Schedule hasn't been generated OR
  • The Billing Schedule amount doesn't match the Net Amount of the quote

fields.name: displayText_DataIssue6

  • Any one of several critical fields may be blank
  • The quote has Training products but no customer Point of Contact
  • The Downstream Partner is a Distributor﻿
  • The Deployment Provider is blank on a New Customer or New MSP End User opportunity
